Tryb: zdalny

Bardzo dobra, praktyczna znajomość Angulara oraz TypeScript, w tym znajomość nowoczesnego podejścia do Angulara: standalone components, signals oraz nowoczesne zarządzanie stanem,

Praktyczne doświadczenie w tworzeniu i utrzymywaniu testów end-to-end,

Samodzielność w realizacji zadań oraz dbałość o jakość i czytelność tworzonego kodu.

Współpracując z naszą organizacją będziesz mógł/mogła liczyć na:
Ugruntowaną pozycją rynkową

Projekty, w których będziesz miał/miała wpływ na ich rozwój

Współpracę z atrakcyjnymi klientami biznesowymi z różnych branż (m.in.: finanse, bankowość, ubezpieczenia, healthcare, robotyzacja, energetyka, media)

Bieżące informacje projektowe oraz stały dostęp do dokumentacji niezbędnej do realizacji zadań (np. Git, Gitflow, Angular, Docker, Primaris x TechTalks, Primaris Leadership Academy)

Świetną atmosferę współpracy podczas realizacji projektów wśród zaangażowanych ludzi z pasją

Cały proces nawiązywania współpracy oraz onboarding prowadzony jest zdalnie.
Proces nawiązywania współpracy składa się z:
rozmowy telefonicznej (do 30 min)

zdalnej video rozmowy - weryfikacji techniczno-biznesowej z naszym specjalistą/specjalistką (60-90 min)

zdalnego spotkania z Product Owner projektu (30-60 min)

Primaris Services to ponad 250 ekspertów na pokładzie i 15 lat doświadczenia w branży IT na rynku polskim oraz zagranicznym. Realizujemy ambitne projekty o wysokiej złożoności z różnych obszarów - m.in. bankowości, ubezpieczeń, healthcare, robotyzacji, energetyki, mediów (mamy ponad 40 aktywnych klientów). Rośniemy w siłę oraz ciągle poszerzamy portfolio zarówno naszych usług jak i klientów.
Zakres naszej działalności obejmuje budowę systemów od zera, ich rozwój oraz utrzymanie,  wdrożenia produktowe, alokacje całych Zespołów, a także pojedynczych Ekspertów w strukturach Klienta.
Ponadto od kilku lat działamy bardzo intensywnie jako złoty Partner firmy UiPath (obszar Robotic Process Automation) budując roboty i sprzedając licencje u naszych Klientów. Co miesiąc nawiązujemy współpracę z 7 nowymi osobami. Wierzymy, że ludzie z pasją to klucz do naszego wspólnego sukcesu! Właśnie dlatego ciągle poszukujemy nowych, zdolnych osób, które powiększą grono naszych współpracowników.

title: PDGS Fullstack Developer (Regular)
description:
Employment type: FULL_TIME
Applicants must be located in: Poland
Overall:
At Creotech, we build cutting-edge software solutions for the Space & Earth Observation (EO) industry. We develop advanced system that processes, catalogs, and delivers satellite imagery and scientific payload data to commercial partners, research institutions, and international space agencies.
We are looking for a skilled and passionate Software Developer to join our Payload Data Ground Segment Engineering team. In this role, you will be responsible for developing our Payload Data Ground System (PDGS) and our modern User Access Service (UAS) platform.
About the role:
As a Software Developer in our team, you will operate at the intersection of high-performance backend pipelines and geospatial web delivery systems.
You will design automated ingestion & processing workflows for satellite payload streams and construct high-availability APIs (STAC/REST) that allow users to search, filter, and stream earth observation assets seamlessly.
Key responsibilities
Work on innovative software solutions for satellite payload data ordering, reception, processing, archiving and distribution

Contribute to system development process across the full lifecycle (design, prototyping, developing, maintaining)

Implement automated workflows for processing of raw payload data into standardized EO products (GeoTIFF, COG)

Write clean, efficient, well-documented and testable code.

Manage software engineering fundamentals, including documentation, version control, and team collaboration.

Identify and resolve bugs and issues

Deploy and monitor developed systems

Requirements (fundamental):
Minimum of 2 year of professional software development experience in Python or/and JavaScript, TypeScript, Java

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field or equivalent experience

Proven experience in web apps (Angular, React or similar) development

Knowledge of SQL, NoSQL databased (e.g. PostgreSQL, MongoDB)

Experienced with GIT and CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI)

Self-driven and capable of working independently in a full remote team environment

Knowledge about clean code, unit testing, git workflows, CICD automation

Comfortable working or ability to learn a Linux environment

Nice to Have:
Knowledge and/or experience in space sector projects related with satellite data processing performed for example for ESA. Knowledge of PDGS terminology and standards e.g. image quality.

Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, S3 objects storage (e.g. AWS S3, MinIO)

Familiarity with EO standards and formats: STAC specification, GeoTIFF, COG, GeoJSON

Experience with Geospatial tooling: PySTAC, GDAL, Rasterio, Shapely, NumPy

Experience with workflow engines (e.g. Apache Airflow, Prefect, Argo Workflows)

Knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP

Familiarity with DevOps practices and infrastructure as code (e.g., Terraform, Ansible)

Knowledge of web mapping libraries (CesiumJS, OpenLayers, Leaflet, Mappbox GL)

Experience with automated testing frameworks and tools (e.g., Selenium, Cypress)

 We offer
Work in a friendly, well-coordinated team of enthusiasts

Stable employment in a modern company with an established market position

Attractive salary and benefits package (e.g., private medical care, sports card)

Opportunities for professional development and participation in innovative projects

An overview of this role

GitLab’s Forward Deployed Engineering team is a field-situated product engineering function focused on strategic customer outcomes, artificial intelligence (AI) adoption, and direct contributions to GitLab’s product. This isn't a traditional field engineering, solutions architecture, or professional services role. As a Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll work closely with customers while maintaining the technical standards and contribution discipline of a Staff-level product engineer.

You'll work where strategic customer urgency, complex technical ambiguity, and GitLab product execution intersect. You'll partner directly with strategic customers and teams across Product, Engineering, Support, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Solutions Architecture (SA), Customer Success Architecture (CSA), Customer Success Management (CSM), and Professional Services. You'll diagnose and resolve high-impact adoption blockers, contribute production-quality fixes and features, and turn what you learn into repeatable patterns for GitLab and its customers.

Why this role exists

Strategic customers sometimes encounter challenges that are too broad, deep, urgent, or cross-functional for any single team to own from start to finish. These challenges may involve product gaps, performance degradation, scale bottlenecks, AI governance, adoption blockers, architectural constraints, Git usage patterns, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) complexity, application programming interface (API) automation, security requirements, or operational instability.

Forward Deployed Engineering provides technical stewardship in these moments. The team doesn't simply observe, report, or escalate. You'll engage directly, diagnose the underlying technical problem, collaborate with the right teams, contribute code or technical solutions where appropriate, and transition the outcome into normal ownership once the customer is stable and the learning can be reused.

What you’ll do

Product contribution

  • Contribute production-quality code to GitLab’s product and adjacent systems.
  • Develop bug fixes, features, integrations, tooling, and performance improvements when strategic customer outcomes require direct engineering work.
  • Work within GitLab’s product and engineering processes, including issue discovery, merge request creation, testing, review, documentation, and maintainability.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering so customer-driven solutions support long-term product direction rather than becoming one-off customizations.
  • Turn blockers discovered in the field into durable product improvements, reference architectures, documentation, and repeatable implementation patterns.

Strategic technical stewardship

  • Engage with strategically important customers when adoption, retention, executive confidence, or public trust is materially at risk.
  • Diagnose complex problems across GitLab product behavior, customer architecture, Git internals, CI/CD workflows, API usage, observability, infrastructure, networking, and cloud environments.
  • Coordinate across Product, Engineering, SRE, Support, SA, CSA, CSM, Professional Services, and customer technical teams to drive resolution from discovery through handoff.
  • Provide recommendations grounded in data, traces, and systems analysis to improve GitLab usage, workflows, automation, and architecture.
  • Create durable outcomes without establishing permanent dependency on Forward Deployed Engineering.

AI adoption and agentic software development lifecycle

  • Drive governed, measurable, and production-oriented adoption of GitLab Duo Agent Platform with strategic customers.
  • Identify and resolve AI adoption blockers involving governance, usage controls, auditability, security, compliance, operating models, workflow design, and integrations.
  • Develop customer-safe adoption patterns for the agentic software development lifecycle (SDLC), AI-assisted development, intent-based review, AI governance, and human-in-the-loop software delivery.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Fullstack) - Merchant EMEA
description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

About the Team

Merchant EMEA Engineering builds the technology that helps merchants join, grow, and operate successfully across our markets.

Our organization brings together the strengths of Wolt and Deliveroo and supports merchants across 37 countries. We work across the merchant journey, including onboarding, business growth and support, analytics and recommendations, menu and order management, integrations, and merchant applications.

Our teams sit close to the business. Rather than primarily building foundational platforms, we build products and features on top of our existing platforms to solve real merchant and market needs, including local business requirements, growth opportunities, and operational challenges.

📍This open role is based in our tech hubs in Helsinki or Berlin.

Please note: This role requires being based in Berlin/Helsinki on a hybrid basis. We are currently unable to offer fully remote work, visa sponsorship, or relocation support for this opportunity.

 

What You'll Do

As a Fullstack Engineer, you'll contribute to products and services used across the merchant experience. You'll:

  • Build and maintain production software across backend services and user-facing applications.
  • Work on areas such as merchant onboarding, analytics, recommendations, menu and order management, integrations, or merchant-facing tools.
  • Develop reliable APIs, data models, services, and user-facing features.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, operations, and other engineers to turn business needs into practical technical solutions.
  • Own features from implementation through production and ongoing maintenance.
  • Contribute to technical design discussions and improve the quality, scalability, observability, and maintainability of our systems.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools effectively as part of your engineering workflow, while critically evaluating their output and taking ownership of the final solution.
  • Be willing to work outside your primary area of expertise when needed to solve the problem end-to-end.

 

How We Work

  • Ownership: Engineers take responsibility for the features and services they work on, from development to production.
  • Collaboration: We work closely across engineering, product, design, data, and operations.
  • Pragmatism: We value simple and maintainable solutions that create business impact without unnecessary complexity.
  • Flexibility: We care more about solving the problem than strict frontend or backend boundaries.

 

Our Tech Stack

Our backend services primarily use Go and Kotlin, while our frontend applications use technologies such as TypeScript and React.

We also work with technologies including Kafka, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, gRPC, and modern cloud infrastructure.

 

Our Humble Expectations

We're looking for engineers who have:

  • An AI-first mindset, with a deep experience in leveraging modern AI tools and solid engineering principles to solve problems end-to-end, independently of any specific technology stack.
  • Proven experience building production software in backend, frontend, or fullstack environments end-to-end and at scale.
  • Strong expertise in at least one area of the stack, with a willingness to contribute outside that area when needed.
  • Experience with a modern backend language such as Go, Kotlin, Java, or similar, and/or modern frontend technologies such as TypeScript and React.
  • Good understanding of APIs, databases, testing, and software design fundamentals.
  • The ability to work independently on well-scoped problems and collaborate effectively with others.
  • Good communication skills and a pragmatic, collaborative mindset.

You do not need to be equally strong in frontend and backend. We welcome different balances of experience. You might be primarily a backend engineer who is comfortable making frontend changes when needed, or a frontend-focused engineer who is happy to work with APIs and backend services.

What matters most is that you are comfortable working across boundaries to deliver the right solution.

 

Nice to Have

Experience in one or more of the following areas would be a plus:

  • Merchant-facing or internal operational tools.
  • Analytics, recommendations, or decisioning systems.
  • Grocery, retail, restaurants, logistics, or marketplace technology.
  • Integrations with external business systems.
  • Kafka [truncated]

title: Feltsense AI Engineer
description:
About the company
We raised $5.1M to build agents that operate as fully autonomous founders. Our backers include Matt Schlicht (founder of Moltbook), the founders of Crunchbase and Republic, and VCs including Draper, Precursor, and Liquid2.
We're working at the frontier of autonomous systems, building agents that don't just chat, but run entire businesses.
Our system identifies business opportunities through market signals, validates ideas with live ad tests, builds and launches software products, and brings in human experts wherever agents fall short. That loop already runs end to end: from idea to launched product to first revenue.
Over the next 12 months, our focus is on reliability, throughput, and self-improvement, making every launch better than the last.

About the role
We're looking for a hands-on AI Engineer to take ownership of the architecture and development of our autonomous agent system.
You'll lead the technical direction of the platform, building multi-agent orchestration systems, self-improving agent harnesses, and AI-powered backend services. This is a highly technical leadership role that combines architectural decision-making with hands-on engineering.
You'll be expected to ship production code, make key technical decisions, improve agent behavior in production, and help establish the engineering standards as the company scales.

Responsibilities
Own the system architecture and make key technical decisions across the platform.

Design and build multi-agent systems and orchestration infrastructure that take products from idea to launch.

Develop self-improving agent harnesses, including feedback loops, evaluation systems, and memory.

Build and maintain AI-powered backend services on top of LLM APIs such as Anthropic, OpenAI, and Gemini.

Write production code, particularly around agent runtime and orchestration.

Debug and improve AI behavior in production through prompt engineering, structured outputs, retries, and fallbacks.

Break down complex technical challenges into actionable milestones and prioritize the engineering roadmap.

Establish engineering standards around code reviews, testing, observability, and release processes.

Lead and support the engineering team while remaining deeply involved in implementation.

Requirements
4+ years of professional software engineering experience.

Previous technical leadership experience at an early-stage company (Founding Engineer, Tech Lead, Head of Engineering, or similar).

Hands-on experience building and shipping multi-agent systems and orchestration frameworks to production.

Experience developing self-improving or self-evolving agent harnesses.

Strong backend engineering skills, including designing and maintaining APIs, services, and data flows.

Experience working with LLM-based systems, including prompt engineering, model configuration, structured outputs, embeddings, retrieval, and evaluation.

Daily hands-on experience with AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, or similar tools. You should know how to delegate work to agents, review their output, and verify what they build.

Nice to have
Strong TypeScript and Node.js experience.

Experience with Vercel AI SDK, Claude Agent SDK, or building custom agent runtimes.

Experience with PostgreSQL, Supabase, and pgvector.

Familiarity with background job systems such as Inngest or Pub/Sub.

Experience with Zod, Vitest, and GCP Cloud Run.

Experience growing or restructuring distributed engineering teams.

Interest in AI evaluation, safety, and observability.
